steps.note: brand fire part 1: re-walk the Select FRESH — up from the visible 请输入 input, never a stashed instance. Two poison sources: (1) the tree has a SECOND p-20000 instance whose onChange writes {"undefined":null}; (2) ANY stashed instance goes stale as binding re-renders the form — a stale closure writes to a dead engine binding, same garbage. The engine's catProp commit is ASYNC (~1s) — the next step waits for it
engine catProp committed as {p-20000:{value:-1,text:...}} — the client validator's passing shape. If this never lands the instance was stale and the run is dead
